newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cahya Mata makes general offer for BUMB.
newsitem.headline: Cahya Mata makes general offer for BUMB.

text.p: Malaysian infrastructure construction firm Cahya Mata Sarawak Bhd has made a mandatory general offer to acquire the remaining 110.98 million shares in financial group BUMB Holdings Bhd which it does not own.

The offer followed the completion of Cahya Mata's acquisition of the entire equity interest in Concordance Sdn Bhd for 445.5 million ringgit to be satisified by the issue of 37.125 million new CMS shares at 12.00 ringgit per share.

In a statement released late on Friday, Cahya Mata said it was offering to buy BUMB shares either through an exchange of four BUMB shares for one Cahya Mata share or 3.0 ringgit in cash for each BUMB share, or any combination of the two.
Concordance together with two of its units own 57.23 percent of BUMB, which in turn owns a commercial bank, a merchant bank and a finance company.
Analysts have said that the merger would turn the group into an infrastructural and financial giant.
Cahya Mata shares closed on Friday at 17.40 ringgit.
